Remark
[the Heisenberg group]

Source: petersen:page-0178 ↗ def:pet-ch4-left-invariant-metric-lie 1. ch4:4.7.22For the Heisenberg group $G$ of upper unitriangular $3\times 3$ matrices with Lie algebra basis $X,Y,Z$: (1) show the only nonzero bracket is $[X,Y]=Z$; declare $X,Y,Z$ orthonormal for a left-invariant metric. (2) Show $\mathrm{Ric}$ has both positive and negative eigenvalues. (3) Show $\mathrm{scal}$ is constant. (4) Show $\mathrm{Ric}$ is not parallel.
